aboutText: With over 25 years of experience, ORB Constructions has been transforming homes across Melbourne's west. Based in Essendon, we specialise in ground floor extensions, second storey additions, and complete home renovations. Our team is dedicated to delivering high-quality craftsmanship from concept to completion, ensuring your vision becomes reality without compromise.
servicesText: We offer a full range of home renovation services, from initial design consultations to final touches. Our expertise includes kitchen refurbishments, bathroom renovations, and house extensions, all tailored to your needs in Essendon and surrounding suburbs.

reviews.text: ORB Constructions did an amazing job on our kitchen refurbishment in Essendon. The team was professional, and the quality of work exceeded our expectations. Highly recommended for any home renovation.
reviews.name: Sarah Mitchell

reviews.text: We hired them for a second storey extension, and from concept to completion, the process was smooth. Their experience with 25+ years in the trade showed in every detail. A reliable choice for Melbourne homes.
reviews.name: James Thompson

reviews.text: As a property manager, I've worked with many builders, but ORB Constructions stands out for their attention to detail and adherence to timelines. Our bathroom renovations in Footscray were completed on schedule.
reviews.name: David Chen
